column1: # ARM DDI 0487 C4.1.91 Reserved & C6.2.439 UDF: (word & 0xffff0000) == 0x00000000.
# Enumerates 1,035 unique 0x0000xxxx encodings (all 0x0000..0x00ff, all 0xff00..0xffff, page bases/diagonals,
# single-bit set/clear, and signed/hex boundaries) plus 48 high-16-bit != 0 counterexamples (.long), totaling 1,083 rows.
# Reference tool version: Apple LLVM version 21.0.0
# Assembly command: xcrun clang -arch arm64e udf.s -o udf.macho
# Generation command: python3 -I Scripts/acceptance/encoding-table.py generate udf
